name: Template
notes: A new puzzle starts as this file (tools/puzzle.sh new <id> --level easy|medium). Edit the pieces, then run tools/puzzle.sh check <id>, then tools/puzzle.sh render <id> and look at docs/design/puzzles/<id>.png. The guide is docs/puzzles.md. Every piece's 'at' is its outline's centre on the 80 x 72 board, measured from the top left; a shape's points are in board units round its own centre (0, 0), so keep (0, 0) inside the shape.
